scope: Additive Stick Horse L1-27 permanent King Equipment audit of deployment duration, wall traversal, movement and attack effects.
game_version: Official 2026-02 Wise Warriors release; claimed client build 18.600.3 in 2026-09-18 page; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: Wise Warriors Medal Event is here!
facts: Stick Horse is a new Epic Barbarian King Equipment released in the Wise Warriors event.
It lets the King hop over Walls with increased speed and damage for a limited time after deployment.
sources.limitations: The article does not give duration by level, movement units, jump path cost, collision, attack cadence or whether Wall hopping lasts as long as the speed and damage increase.

sources.title: About Heroes & Pets
facts: The Home Village Hero equipment table assigns Stick Horse to the Barbarian King.
sources.limitations: The table does not publish combat timing or pathfinding.

sources.title: Stick Horse — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: The TH18 maximum is L27. Per-level Hero HP and DPS boosts, ore costs and Blacksmith requirements match the pinned payload.
sources.limitations: The public table omits current ability duration, movement speed, attack speed and Wall-hop contract.

sources.title: Pinned Stick Horse Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: Each level retains abilityDuration, movementSpeedIncrease, attackSpeedIncrease, dpsIncrease and hitpointIncrease. The recorded duration progresses from 12 to 30 seconds; movement field from 9.5 to 24; attack speed field from +2% to +33%.
sources.limitations: The movement number's units and whether it is an additive or absolute speed are unspecified. The payload does not define Wall-hop pathing, collision, buff start/end tick or stat stacking.

sources.title: Stick Horse
facts: The indexed history reports a February 23, 2026 fix for Jump Spell suppressing Stick Horse Wall hopping.
sources.limitations: The page could not be fetched directly during this audit and no matching primary patch statement was found. The current precedence rule remains unverified.

level_field_summary.movementSpeedIncrease: 9.5 at L1 to 24 at L27; units unspecified

observations.note: All 27 exact per-level values remain in the SHA-pinned frozen raw payload and normalized catalogue; this audit does not reclassify them as verified current combat values.

derivations.result: Retain Hero HP, DPS and upgrade data only
derivations.method: Cross-check the dated claimed-build public table against the SHA-pinned 27-level raw series. No speed or pathing formula is derived.
The primary release says the effect is limited after deployment, but provides no precise start/end event order or Wall-hop duration. Pinned durations are kept as catalogue values only.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat movementSpeedIncrease as an additive speed in Core
rejected_inferences.reason: The numeric field has no documented unit or conversion into the fixed-tick movement scale.

rejected_inferences.rule: Give the King permanent Wall crossing while Stick Horse is equipped
rejected_inferences.reason: The official release describes limited-time post-deployment ability and does not distinguish Wall-hop duration from speed and damage duration.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use a Jump Spell's Wall pathing and priority for Stick Horse
rejected_inferences.reason: A community history reports a Jump Spell interaction fix, but no checked source defines current combined path cost and precedence.

rejected_inferences.rule: Compute attack interval as base interval divided by one plus the pinned percent
rejected_inferences.reason: The game-specific cadence rounding and stacking with other Equipment, Rage and auras are not sourced.

rejected_inferences.rule: Start the duration on the first post-deployment 10 ms tick
rejected_inferences.reason: The release and raw table do not define whether the deployment tick counts or how expiry interacts with movement and attack events.

items: current duration, movement and attack-speed continuity by level
movement units and integer fixed-tick conversion
Wall-hop path cost, collision clearance and choice against openings
whether Wall hopping expires with speed and damage effects
DPS versus attack-speed application and modifier rounding
Jump Spell, other Equipment, Pet and Phoenix interactions
Viewer trail and sprite rights, snapshot, replay and RL loadout contract

conclusion: Stick Horse L1-27 remains partial and catalogue-only. Supercell establishes a temporary post-deployment King Wall-hop, speed and damage effect, and a dated 2026 table corroborates Hero HP/DPS. Current speed units, pathing and exact duration/order cannot be applied deterministically from the checked sources.
